Look beyond the mound
Fire ants are an unwelcome part of yard work, playtime, and walking the dog. A useful treatment plan considers where people use the lawn and the colony activity beyond the mounds you can easily see.
Point out activity near walkways, play areas, patios, and the lawn your pets use. It helps us understand your priorities.

We review the property, explain the service, and select an application approach that fits the site and the product label.

    Before you book

    Straight answers about fire ant treatment.

    Know what to expect before your lawn is treated.

    Ask our team: (225) 461-3199
    How much does fire ant control in Baton Rouge cost?

    Pricing depends on the area to be treated and the recommended service. Send your address for a free estimate. We’ll explain the price and scope before you approve service.

    Do you treat only the mounds I can see?

    Our approach considers colony activity across the treatment area, not just visible mounds. The service may involve lawn-wide treatment and attention to active problem spots, depending on the plan and product label.

    How often is fire ant treatment scheduled?

    Grow Green’s standard fire ant program includes two planned treatments per year. Your estimate explains the schedule and scope. Contact our team about new or persistent activity between visits so we can review the situation.

    Will every fire ant disappear immediately?

    No. Speed of control varies with the product, application method, colony activity, and conditions. A treatment does not permanently prevent every future colony. We explain what to watch for and when to contact us about continued activity.

    When can children and pets use the yard again?

    Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry and aftercare directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every fire ant treatment.

    What should I do before the visit?

    Keep children and pets away from active mounds, provide access to the treatment area, and tell us about gates, edible gardens, ponds, and recent ant treatments. Avoid disturbing mounds to test them. Ask our team whether mowing or watering needs to be adjusted for your service.

    Can I add fire ant control to my lawn program?

    Yes. Ask for fire ant service to be included in your estimate or added to your existing Grow Green plan. It is a separate service from the regular eight-visit lawn fertilization and weed control program.

    Do you serve areas outside Baton Rouge?

    Yes. Grow Green also serves Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Central, Walker, Zachary, and communities across Ascension and Livingston parishes. Our team confirms service availability using your address.

    General colony-management guidance: Mississippi State University Extension. People and pet precautions: EPA label guidance. Your treatment’s current product label controls the application and aftercare directions.
